title: Roma 2443 - Map Editor: Create & Play Your Own Map in Seconds!
author: Roma2443
selftext:
Hey! Here's a new feature I've been working on for my game.

You can now create your own maps in just a few clicks, with no signup required, and jump straight into a game against a bot with a single click. Other players can also join your map directly through the server browser.

There's also a community system where players can share their maps, upvote or downvote other people's creations, and play them directly from the game, all with just one click.

Just wanted to share what I've been working on. Hope you guys like it!
